Hot Lettuce
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 31, 2009 - 12:27am

Ingredients




1/2 pound Bacon
2 cups Water
1/2 cup Sugar
1/2 cup Vinegar
1/4 cup Flour
1 Egg
Lettuce
Onion, chopped

Preparation

1 Break up lettuce and onion, place in serving bowl and set aside. To make dressing, cook bacon, drain and add water. Mix together sugar, vinegar, flour and egg. Pour into water and bacon, cook until thick. Pour dressing over lettuce while still hot, serve immediately.
